FAQ.TITLE: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.SUBTITLE: Find answers to the most common questions about Fluxnote and its features.
FAQ.Q1: How does AI work in Fluxnote?
FAQ.A1: Fluxnote AI helps with content creation, grammar corrections, improvement suggestions, and automatic formatting. It learns from your writing style and offers personalized suggestions to make your documents more effective.
FAQ.Q2: How many people can collaborate on a document at the same time?
FAQ.A2: The number of collaborators depends on your plan: the Free plan supports up to 2 people, Pro up to 10, and the Team plan offers unlimited collaboration. All changes are synced in real time.
FAQ.Q3: Is my data safe in Fluxnote?
FAQ.A3: Yes—security is our priority. We use end-to-end encryption, secure cloud storage, and comply with GDPR. Your documents are private and only accessible to you and the people you authorize.
FAQ.A4: Fluxnote is primarily online to ensure real-time syncing. However, we offer limited offline functionality that lets you view and edit recent documents, with automatic syncing when you're back online.
FAQ.A5: Every change is automatically saved. You can review previous versions, compare changes, and restore any earlier version. The Free plan keeps 7 days of history, while paid plans offer full history.
FAQ.Q6: Can I import documents from other platforms?
FAQ.A6: Yes. Fluxnote supports imports from Microsoft Word, Google Docs, PDF, and other popular formats. Formatting is preserved and you can start collaborating right after import.
FAQ.Q7: How do I cancel my subscription?
FAQ.A7: You can cancel anytime from your account settings. You'll keep access to premium features until the end of your billing period, and you can subscribe again whenever you like.
FAQ.Q8: Is there a mobile version of Fluxnote?
FAQ.A8: Yes. Fluxnote is fully responsive and works great on mobile devices in your browser. Native iOS and Android apps are also in development and will be available soon.
FAQ.Q9: What types of documents can I create?
FAQ.A9: Fluxnote is versatile—you can create reports, proposals, articles, presentations, manuals, contracts, and any kind of text document. The AI adapts to the type of content you're creating.
FAQ.A10: We offer email support for all users, priority support for Pro users, and dedicated support for teams. We also provide a full knowledge base and video tutorials.

HELP.TITLE: How can we help you?
HELP.SUBTITLE: Search our knowledge base or browse categories below
HELP.STILL_HELP_DESC: Our support team is available 24/7 to assist you with any questions or issues.
HELP.CAT_AI_DESC: Leverage AI to enhance your work
HELP.FAQ_Q1: How do I create and share a document?
HELP.FAQ_A1: Create a document from the Dashboard by clicking the "New Document" button. Once inside the editor, click "Share" to generate an invite link with a role (Viewer or Editor) and expiration date.
HELP.FAQ_A2: Fluxnote saves a new version of your document automatically each time you close an editing session. Open the "History" panel inside the editor to browse, compare and restore previous versions.
HELP.FAQ_Q3: How do I collaborate in real time?
HELP.FAQ_A3: Any user with Editor access can open the same document simultaneously. Changes are synced live — you will see collaborators' names highlighted as you edit.
HELP.FAQ_Q4: How do I use the AI features?
HELP.FAQ_A4: Inside any document, open the "AI Assistance" panel to generate content or get a summary. Select text and click "Improve with AI" to receive improvement suggestions for that specific passage.
HELP.FAQ_Q5: How are teams and permissions organised?
HELP.FAQ_A5: Create a team and invite members with Owner, Team Admin or Member roles. Inside a team’s detail page, you can also configure per-document permissions (Viewer or Editor) for individual members.
HELP.FAQ_Q6: What file types can I use as AI context?
HELP.FAQ_A6: You can upload PDF or TXT files as context for the AI assistant. These files are used to ground AI-generated content in your own materials and help the AI produce more relevant results.
